section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Instruments and Sender Gauges
title: Fuel Gauge

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Disconnect the connector from the fuel sender gauge. Turn the ignition switch on and check that the receiver gauge needle moves to the empty position.

content.description: Wiring diagram showing fuel gauge connected to ignition switch and test bulb 3.4W. Shows connections between fuel gauge, ignition switch, test bulb, and receiver gauge with battery ground.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Connect the 3.4W test bulb between terminal 2 and body ground. Check that the bulb lights and the receiver gauge needle operates.

content.text: Because of the silicon oil in the gauge, it will take about 90 seconds for the needle to stabilize.
If indications are not as specified, remove and test the receiver gauge.

items.title: MEASURE RECEIVER GAUGE RESISTANCE BETWEEN TERMINALS

content.description: Rear view diagram of receiver gauge showing terminal layout. Four terminals labeled IG, U, E, and one unlabeled terminal arranged in a circular pattern.

content.text: If each resistance value is not as shown in the table above, replace the receiver gauge.

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Check that the resistance changes as the float is moved from the top to bottom position.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Measure the resistance between terminals 2 and 3 for each float position.

content.description: Diagram of fuel sender gauge showing float arm mechanism with positions marked F, 1/2, and E. Shows terminals 1, 2, and 3, with measurement points indicated.

content.text: If each resistance value is not as shown in the table above, replace the sender gauge.

substeps.label: (a)
substeps.text: Disconnect the connector from the switch. Connect the switch terminal 1 and body ground.

substeps.label: (b)
substeps.text: Turn the ignition switch on. Check that the bulb lights.

content.description: Wiring diagram showing fuel gauge, ignition switch, test bulb 3.4W, and receiver gauge (H-32) connections for fuel level warning inspection.
